# IConfigurationManaged
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/config-contracts/src/interfaces/IConfigurationManaged.sol)

**Title:**
IConfigurationManaged

Interface for contracts that need to read from the ConfigurationManager

This interface defines the standard methods for accessing configuration values
from the ConfigurationManager. It should be implemented by contracts that
need to read these configurations.


## Functions
### configurationManager

Gets the address of the ConfigurationManager contract


```solidity
function configurationManager() external view returns (IConfigurationManager);
```
**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`IConfigurationManager`|The address of the ConfigurationManager contract|
